import currency
import con_uwarriors_lst001

I = importlib

S = Hash(default_value='')
A = Hash(default_value='')
balances = Hash(default_value=0)
metadata = Hash(default_value=0)
nicks = Hash(default_value=0)
wp = ForeignHash(foreign_contract='con_uwarriors_lst001', foreign_name='balances')

@construct
def seed():
    metadata['operator'] = ctx.caller
    metadata['withdrawal'] = False
    metadata['starter_pack_price'] = 1500
    metadata['game_cost'] = 2
    metadata['time'] = 14
    metadata['fees'] = decimal('0.15')
    metadata['fees_withdrawal'] = decimal('0.20')

@export
def set_nick_name(nickname: str):
    caller = ctx.caller
    assert len(nickname) <= 25, 'Nickname too long (25 chars max).'
    assert len(nickname) > 0, 'Nickname too short.'
    names_uid = hashlib.sha256(nickname.lower().replace(' ', ''))
    assert not nicks['nicknames', names_uid
        ], 'A form of this name already belongs to ' + nicks[
        'nicknames', names_uid]
    nicks[caller, 'nickname'] = nickname
    nicks['nicknames', names_uid] = nickname

@export
def operator_transfer_thing(uid: str, new_owner: str):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only auction operator can transfer things from contract.'
    transfer(uid=uid, new_owner=new_owner,contract=contract)
    A[uid] = False
    
@export
def operator_transfer_currency(amount: str, to: float):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only auction operator can transfer currency from contract.'
    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer(amount=amount, to=to)

def get_listing_info(uid: str):
    # Get listing info
    listing_info = A[uid]
    assert listing_info is not None, "Listing doesn't exist!"
    return {
        'start_date': A[uid, 'start_date'],
        'end_date': A[uid, 'end_date'],
        'current_owner': A[uid, 'current_owner'],
        'uid': A[uid, 'uid'],
        'reserve_price': A[uid, 'reserve_price'],
        'current_bid': A[uid, 'current_bid'],
        'current_winner': A[uid, 'current_winner']
    }

@export
def auction_thing(contract: str, uid: str, reserve_price: float, start_date: datetime.datetime, end_date: datetime.datetime):
    #uid: str, to: str, main_account: str, contract: str
    transfer_from_internal(uid,ctx.this,ctx.caller,contract)
    assert not A[uid], 'Auction has already started!'
    assert end_date > now, "end_date is in the past"
    assert reserve_price >= 0, "reserve_price cannot be less than 0"

    A[uid, 'start_date'] = start_date
    A[uid, 'end_date'] = end_date
    A[uid, 'current_owner'] = ctx.caller
    A[uid, 'uid'] = uid
    A[uid, 'reserve_price'] = reserve_price
    A[uid, 'current_bid'] = None
    A[uid, 'current_winner'] = ""
    
    # Mark as auction started
    A[uid] = True

@export
def end_auction(uid: str, end_early: bool):
    # Get listing info
    listing_info = get_listing_info(uid=uid)

    if end_early:
        # Only the owner or the operator can end an auction early
        assert listing_info['current_owner'] == ctx.caller or metadata['operator'] == ctx.caller, \
               'Only thing owner or auction operator can end the auction early!'

        if now < listing_info['start_date']:
            process_auction_result_no_winner(listing_info)
        else:
            if (listing_info['current_bid'] or -1) < listing_info['reserve_price']:
                process_auction_result_no_winner(listing_info)
            else:
                assert False, "Cannot end early. Auction started or reserve has been met."
    else:
        # Else, anyone can call this to complete the auction, assuming the auction is over
        assert now > listing_info['end_date'], 'Auction is still pending!'
        if listing_info['current_bid'] == None or listing_info['current_bid'] < listing_info['reserve_price']:
            process_auction_result_no_winner(listing_info)
        else:
            process_auction_result(listing_info)

def process_auction_result_no_winner(listing_info, contract):
    transfer(
        uid=listing_info['uid'],
        new_owner=listing_info['current_owner'],
        contract=contract
    )

    # Send money back to last bidder (if there was one)
    if listing_info['current_winner'] != "":
        con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer(
            to=listing_info['current_winner'],
            amount=listing_info['current_bid']
        )

    A[listing_info['uid']] = False

def process_auction_result(listing_info, contract):
    # transfer thing to new owner
    transfer(
        uid=listing_info['uid'],
        new_owner=listing_info['current_winner'],
        contract=contract
    )

    net_amount = listing_info['current_bid']

    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer(
        to=listing_info['current_owner'],
        amount=net_amount
    )

    A[listing_info['uid']] = False

@export
def bid(uid: str, bid_amount: float):
    listing_info = get_listing_info(uid=uid)

    current_bid = listing_info['current_bid'] or 0

    assert now < listing_info['end_date'], "Auction has ended."
    assert now > listing_info['start_date'], "Auction has not stared."
    assert bid_amount > 0 , "Bid must be greater than zero."
    assert bid_amount > current_bid, "Current bid of {current_bid} is higher!"
    # Take the currency bid from the bidder
    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(
        main_account=ctx.caller,
        to=ctx.this,
        amount=bid_amount,
    )
    # Send the previous bidder's bid back to them
    if listing_info['current_winner'] != "":
        con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer(
            to=listing_info['current_winner'],
            amount=listing_info['current_bid']
        )
    # Set the new bid info
    A[uid, 'current_bid'] = bid_amount
    A[uid, 'current_winner'] = ctx.caller

@export
def play():
  sender = ctx.caller
  amount = metadata['game_cost']
  operator = metadata['operator']
  assert wp[sender] > amount , 'Not enough coins to send!'
  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(amount,  metadata['operator'], sender)

@export
def buy_character():
  sender = ctx.caller
  amount = metadata['starter_pack_price']
  operator = metadata['operator']
  assert wp[sender] > amount , 'Not enough coins to send!'
  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(amount,  metadata['operator'], sender)

@export
def change_auction(uid: str, auction: bool, contract: str):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    sender = ctx.caller
    thing_uid = thing_info.change_auction(uid, auction)
    return thing_uid


@export
def change_thing_meta(uid: str,  meta: dict, contract: str):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    thing_uid = thing_info.change_meta(uid, meta)
    return thing_uid

@export
def rewards(uid: str,  amount: float):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator'

    if metadata['withdrawal'] == True:
       balances[uid, 'rewards'] += amount
       balances[uid, 'total_rewards'] += amount
       if balances[uid, 'rewards', 'time'] is None:
            balances[uid, 'rewards', 'time'] = now
    else:
        balances[uid, 'total_rewards'] += amount
        con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(amount, uid, metadata['operator'])

@export
def withdrawal():
    sender = ctx.caller
    assert balances[sender, 'rewards'] > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
      
    if metadata['withdrawal'] == True:
      if (now - balances[sender, 'rewards', 'time']).days > metadata['time']:
        amount = balances[sender, 'rewards']
        con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(amount, sender, metadata['operator'])
        balances[sender, 'rewards'] = 0
        balances[uid, 'rewards', 'time'] = now
      else:
        con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(amount - (amount *  metadata['fees_withdrawal']), sender, metadata['operator'])
        balances[sender, 'rewards'] = 0
        balances[uid, 'rewards', 'time'] = now

@export
def add_meta(uid: str, meta:str, contract: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    thing_uid = thing_info.add_meta(uid, meta, value)
    return thing_uid


@export
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    metadata[key] = value



@export
def create_thing(contract: str, thing_string: str, name: str, owner: str, meta: dict = {}):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    sender = ctx.caller
    thing_uid = thing_info.add_thing(thing_string, name,  meta, owner)
    return thing_uid


@export
def buy_thing(uid: str, contract:str):
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    sender = ctx.caller

    owner = thing_info.get_owner(uid)
    creator = thing_info.get_creator(uid)

    assert_already_owned(uid, sender, contract)

    price_amount = thing_info.get_price_amount(uid)

    assert price_amount, uid + ' is not for sale'
    assert price_amount > 0, uid + ' is not for sale'

    price_amount_pay = price_amount - (price_amount * metadata['fees'])
    
    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(price_amount_pay, owner, sender)
    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from((price_amount * metadata['fees']), metadata['operator'], sender)

    transfer_ownership(uid, sender, contract)


@export
def sell_thing(uid: str, amount: float, description: str, contract:str):
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    auction = thing_info.get_auction(uid)
    assert auction == False, ' is on auction'
    assert_ownership(uid, ctx.caller, contract) 
    thing_info.set_price(uid, amount)


@export
def transfer(uid: str, new_owner: str, contract:str):
    sender = ctx.caller
    assert_ownership(uid, sender, contract)
    assert_already_owned(uid, new_owner, contract)
    transfer_ownership(uid, new_owner, contract)

@export
def approve(uid: str, to: str, contract:str):
    sender = ctx.caller
    assert_ownership(uid, sender, contract)
    balances[sender, uid, to] = True

@export
def revoke(uid: str, to: str):
    balances[ctx.caller, uid, to] = None


def transfer_from_internal(sender: str, uid: str, to: str, main_account: str, contract: str):
    sender = main_account
    assert balances[main_account, uid, sender], "You have not been given approval to transfer this user's item."
    assert_ownership(uid, main_account, contract)

    # transfer
    assert_already_owned(uid, to, contract)
    transfer_ownership(uid, to, contract)

    # revoke the approval
    balances[main_account, uid, sender] = None


@export
def transfer_from(uid: str, to: str, main_account: str, contract: str):
    sender = ctx.caller

    assert balances[main_account, uid, sender], "You have not been given approval to transfer this user's item."
    assert_ownership(uid, main_account, contract)

    # transfer
    assert_already_owned(uid, to, contract)
    transfer_ownership(uid, to, contract)

    # revoke the approval
    balances[main_account, uid, sender] = None


def assert_already_owned(uid: str, sender: str, contract: str):
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    owner = thing_info.get_owner(uid)
    assert owner != sender, uid + ' already owned by ' + sender

def assert_ownership(uid: str, sender, contract: str):
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    owner = thing_info.get_owner(uid)
    assert owner == sender, uid + ' not owned by ' + sender


def transfer_ownership(uid:str, new_owner: str, contract: str):
    thing_info = I.import_module(contract)
    old_owner = thing_info.get_owner(uid)

    thing_info.set_owner(uid, new_owner)
    if thing_info.get_price_amount(uid) > 0:
        thing_info.set_price(uid, 0)
